dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Q3 26: booking evolution expected to outperform Q2 (bookings ~flat over the first 3 weeks of July after -7.6% in Q2, PBs ~+1%); Air IT margin slightly dilutive in H2 (airports/professional-services mix).
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 REVISED (wider, prudent range on Middle East disruption; IATA cut to +1.9% from +4.4%): group revenue cc mid-to-high single-digit, adjusted diluted EPS high single to low double-digit; Air Distribution cut to low-to-mid single-digit; Air IT (high single) and Hospitality (low double-digit) UNCHANGED; adjusted EBIT margin stability and FCF EUR1.35-1.45B MAINTAINED; capex toward the low end (~10% of revenue). Mid-term outlook unchanged.
pointsCles: H1 26: revenue EUR3,335M (+5.1% cc / +2.3% reported), adjusted EBIT EUR1,012M (+4.9% cc, 29.8% margin flat), adjusted diluted EPS +7% cc; FIXED COSTS -0.1% (cloud migration completed end-2025 + containment); FCF EUR472M, leverage 1x, EUR500M buyback completed.

Middle East is the swing factor: IATA negative traffic in April-May (first time in 15 years ex-COVID), bookings -7.6% in Q2 on cancellations then wait-and-see; recovery since June (July bookings ~flat, PBs ~+1%) - guidance prudently widened, with Air Distribution alone downgraded; management base case: 'the worst has happened'.

Structural momentum intact: new Altea PSS win >40M pax/year (deploy by 2027; Altea-first, Nevio later - coexistence assumed), Nevio at 25% of Altea business with public proof points (Finnair ancillaries, BA retailing), Air IT rev/PB +7.5% (Q1's one-third disruption-revenue boost faded in Q2), Hospitality +9.2% (Marriott 1,700 properties live, peak 2027; Accor 2028), IDEMIA SPA signed (approval base case Q2-27, Maroto 'more optimistic than at signing').

AI positioning: 'neutral embedded orchestrator' of AI-enabled travel; founding B2B partner of Google's UCP protocol (hospitality); agentic AI inflates look-to-book ratios - answered with caching, per-booking transaction caps and possible monetization of the search layer (a stated industry-wide challenge).

hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
World #1 in travel technology. H1 2026 validated the diversification-resilience thesis: against a Middle-East shock harsher and longer than assumed (IATA cut 2026 world-traffic growth from +4.4% to +1.9%), Air IT Solutions (+8.7% cc) and Hospitality & Other (+9.2% cc) absorbed the blow, leaving only Air Distribution soft (+1.1% cc, bookings -3.7%). Consequence: FY26 guidance cut (revenue to mid-to-high SD cc, adjusted EPS to high-SD-to-low-DD, ranges widened) - but only on the short-term component; the mid-term ambition is reaffirmed unchanged. Buyback completed; IDEMIA acquisition signed (closing mid-2027, size undisclosed).

== THESIS READ ==
- Diversification works as designed: non-air segments compound through an air-traffic shock. Watch: the H2 bookings-recovery assumption (+3% world traffic) that underpins the guidance.
- The cut is cyclical, not structural - mid-term targets intact, so 2027-2030 keeps setup growth rates on a permanently lower 2026 base (no catch-up modeled). Watch: any touch to the mid-term ambition at FY26 results.
- Capital allocation steady; IDEMIA NOT in the net-debt path (size unknown). Watch: transaction size disclosure and any new buyback.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Adjusted (APM) basis throughout, consistent with guidance and unchanged since setup. Amadeus 'adjusted profit' adds back PPA amortization/impairments net of tax below adjusted EBIT: the bridge carries a documented +169M residual on published 2025 for this reason, and projected years absorb the wedge in the effective tax/finNet fit.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026 rebuilt bottom-up: H1 actual (revenue 3,334.9M, adj EBIT 1,011.5M) + H2 on the lowered guidance (~5.5% cc revenue, margin ~29.3%). 2027-2030: ~10%/yr EPS growth per the unchanged mid-term ambition, applied to the lower base. Bridge: ETR 24% wedge (see SPECIAL FACTORS). Net debt to 650M by 2030 excluding IDEMIA. Buyback trajectory: shares 446 -> 431M. Watch: full transcript access was restricted this refresh (summary only); IDEMIA size; Air Distribution stabilization.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 results (Nov); traffic normalization post-shock; IDEMIA size disclosure and closing (mid-2027); potential new buyback announcement.

ancrages.moteur: Guidance FY26 abaissee au S1 suite a l'aggravation du choc Moyen-Orient : CA groupe 'mid-to-high single-digit' (vs 'high-single-digit'), EPS dilue ajuste 'high-single to low-double-digit' (vs 'low-double-digit'). Bridge H1 actual (3 334,9 M€ CA, 1 011,5 M€ adj EBIT) + H2 estime sur la guidance abaissee.

Risque identifie a la creation (perturbations Moyen-Orient) desormais materialise a un degre superieur : IATA a coupe son hypothese de trafic mondial 2026 de +4,4% a +1,9%, reservations Amadeus -3,7% au S1 avec creux mars-avril-mai ; reprise amorcee en juin/juillet mais nature (rattrapage vs inflexion durable) non tranchee par le management lui-meme.

Air IT Solutions (+8,7% cc) et Hospitality & Other Solutions (+9,2% cc) compensent largement la faiblesse d'Air Distribution (+1,1% cc) - confirme la these de resilience par la diversification retenue a la creation, contient l'ampleur du trim de guidance au niveau groupe.

Ambition moyen terme reaffirmee sans changement par le CFO malgre le trim FY26 (CAGR CA high-single-digit, expansion de marge) - memes taux de croissance annuels retenus qu'a la creation (~10%/an) mais appliques a une base 2026 desormais plus basse, decalage permanent vers le bas plutot que rattrapage.

Programme de rachat de 500 M€ (annonce fin fevrier) integralement complete en juin 2026 - dette nette en hausse temporaire (2 577,5 M€ au 30/06, +436 M€ vs fin 2025) du fait du rachat et du dividende, desendettement attendu au S2 porte par le FCF (guidance FY26 inchangee a 1,35-1,45 Md€), sans nouveau programme annonce a ce stade.

Acquisition IDEMIA Public Security desormais sous Share Purchase Agreement signe (vs intention a la creation), cloture reglementaire visee mi-2027 - effet financier toujours non communique par le management, maintenu hors base centrale (optionnalite non chiffree) plutot qu'integre aux adjXXX, taille de transaction a integrer dans omniumND des qu'elle sera connue.
ancrages.confiance: haute sur l'occurrence, nulle sur le montant

2025.residualNote: Amadeus 'adjusted profit' adds back PPA amortization and impairments NET OF TAX below the adjusted-EBIT line, so a flat tax-on-adjusted-EBIT understates it by ~169M. Projected years absorb this wedge in a lower effective finNet/ETR fit (conversion ~73-76% observed).
